annotations.title: Move a batch of scheduled posts

description: Move 1 to 20 queued deliveries to new future times atomically in one call (Studio and Pro). Call it only after the user said yes. If any delivery cannot be moved or falls past the plan’s schedule horizon, nothing is moved.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

items.description: One to 20 queued deliveries to move atomically.

id.description: A queued delivery id from jobs_list or schedule.

scheduledAt.description: The new future posting time, in UTC ending in Z.

name: jobs_reschedule_batch
title: Move a batch of scheduled posts
